test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Yamini is a great singer. She will __make it big__ one day.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (1) i.e. **'Succeed and become famous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To** "make it big":** To achieve great success and/or fame (बहुत सफल और/या प्रसिद्ध होना)

 
 
• **Example**: He has all the talent to make it big in the music industry one day.
 
 
 
• **Succeed and become famous:** (सफल होना और प्रसिद्ध होना) 
 
• This option 1 directly reflects the idiom's meaning related to achieving notable success and gaining recognition or fame in one’s field.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Succeed and become famous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Become financially sound:** This option focuses solely on financial success, which does not fully encompass the broader success and recognition implied by "making it big".
 
• **Educated and rich:** While being educated and wealthy are aspects of success, they do not directly capture the essence of achieving widespread recognition or fame addressed in the idiom.
 
• **Migrate and settle:** This refers to the process of moving and establishing oneself in a new place, which is unrelated to the concept of achieving success and fame.

46:T871,
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. "Kindness"
